latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Image to Video AI.

- Convert still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 video clips in 30–60 seconds, using a cloud GPU backend.
- Simple first-time setup with automatic connection and free token (100 credits, 7 days).
- Supports batch uploads, guided actions (edit, add transitions, BGM, text, etc.), and timeline preview.
- Provides clear API-based workflows for upload, edit, export, and checking credits or status.
- Includes robust error handling and tips for best video results.
- No local installation required; everything runs securely on remote servers.
